messages:
Priya: Seeing surge of TLS client auth failures from ap-northeast->eu-west since ~04:05 UTC. Errors in egress-proxy: `handshake failure (alert 40)` and `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`. :warning:
Priya: Happening right after an RBAC key policy push that removed a service principal from `alias/ephemeral-certs` key.
Sam: Which principal was removed? PR id?
Priya: PR infra/iam#1251 — removed `arn:aws:iam::222:role/cert-proxy-decrypt` from key policy as part of a cleanup. Patch snippet:
```
-    "KeyPolicy": {
-      "Statement": [{"Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::222:role/cert-proxy-decrypt"}, "Effect": "Allow", "Action": "kms:Decrypt"}, ...]
-    }
+    "KeyPolicy": { /* cert-proxy principal removed */ }
```
Yusuf: If cert-proxy can't call KMS:Decrypt to unwrap ephemeral key material we won't be able to present/validate leaf certs -> handshake drops.
Priya: @audit-bot: pull KMS decrypt::Denied/Allowed for alias/ephemeral-certs 04:00-04:10 UTC please.
audit-bot: Summary results:
- 04:02:11 UTC decrypt::Allowed principal=arn:aws:iam::222:role/cert-rotator requestId=zzz-101
- 04:04:55 UTC decrypt::Denied principal=arn:aws:iam::222:role/cert-proxy-decrypt reason=NotFoundInPolicy requestId=zzz-202
- 04:06:02 UTC decrypt::Denied principal=arn:aws:iam::222:role/cert-proxy-decrypt reason=NotFoundInPolicy requestId=zzz-203
- 04:09:12 UTC decrypt::Allowed principal=arn:aws:iam::222:role/cert-proxy-decrypt requestId=zzz-300
Sam: So the revert happened around 04:09? Who did that?
Priya: I rolled back the key policy at 04:08:50 UTC (manual revert) and pushed infra/iam#1252.
oncall-bot: Incident snapshot created: INC-9182. Paging suspended for 30m per Priya.
Yusuf: For immediate mitigation we should: 1) re-add principal (done), 2) toggle proxy to serve from in-memory cert cache for 10m if unwrap fails, 3) add transient alert suppression while we verify.
Sam: Agree. Longer term: require any change touching KMS key policies to run a dry-run smoke test in staging that verifies the unwrap path. Add a 2-approver rule for key policy removals.
Priya: I'll file followups: SEC-5401 (RCA + timeline), IAM-204 (policy change gating), INFRA-865 (staging unwrap smoke test).
Priya: Quick RCA notes: cause = key policy prune removed decrypt principal used by egress cert proxy; detection = elevated proxy TLS fail rate + KMS audit deny entries; mitigation = revert key policy, enable cache fallback; follow-ups = change process + smoke test + audit gating.
Sam: Can we add a tiny smoke test example to INFRA-865 so it's actionable? e.g. `kubectl exec -it proxy -- openssl s_client -connect proxy.eu-west:443 -cert /tmp/test-client.pem -key /tmp/test-client.key` that forces the unwrap path?
Yusuf: Also add KMS audit alert rule: if decrypt::Denied events for `alias/ephemeral-certs` exceed 5 within 5m -> page seceng and infra.
Priya: Done. I'll attach the audit excerpts and the revert PR links to SEC-5401.
Sam: Nice work catching it fast. Small ask: add the timeframe of impact to the incident record (04:04-04:09 UTC) and note affected regions.
Priya: Added. Closing thread, will update tickets as they move. :white_check_mark:
